reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch G1 (dp pictographs re-review), 2026-08-16

samples_reviewed.question_text: Look at the data: cats: 1, dogs: 3, birds: 2, fish: 2. Draw one 🐾 for each item in the picture graph.
Complete the picture graph for apples: 3, bananas: 2, mangoes: 4, grapes: 3. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: roses: 5, sunflowers: 5, tulips: 1, daisies: 2. Draw one 🌸 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: Monday: 4, Tuesday: 4, Wednesday: 3, Thursday: 1. Draw one 📖 for each item.
Look at the data: cats: 4, dogs: 1, birds: 5, fish: 5. Draw one 🐾 for each item in the picture graph.
Complete the picture graph for Grade 1: 5, Grade 2: 5, Grade 3: 4, Grade 4: 3. Draw one ⭐ for each item.
The survey shows: Monday: 3, Tuesday: 2, Wednesday: 3, Thursday: 3. Make a picture graph by drawing one 📖 for each item.
Look at the data: basketball: 2, volleyball: 3, swimming: 2, running: 4. Draw one ⚽ for each item in the picture graph.
Look at the data: Monday: 3, Tuesday: 4, Wednesday: 2, Thursday: 5. Draw one 📖 for each item in the picture graph.
Make a picture graph to show: Math: 5, Science: 5, English: 1, Art: 1. Draw one 📚 for each item.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The generator successfully translates the data sets into interactive tasks where the student populates a pictograph. Because the student is actively plotting the data by placing symbols, it successfully executes the competency constraint to "Present data in a pictograph without a scale."

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The problem set tests the skill across a wide variety of categorical data types, including animals, fruits, days of the week, grade levels, and school subjects, providing robust coverage of the concept.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The numerical values required for the data sets range exclusively from 1 to 5. This strict limit on magnitude is perfectly calibrated for Grade 1 students, preventing cognitive overload from counting large quantities.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The problems successfully cycle through distinct framing contexts, such as organizing survey results, completing existing graphs, and building graphs from scratch, offering sufficient structural variation for the competency.

competency_alignment.rationale: The generator is tightly focused on the core task of data presentation. It successfully avoids introducing out-of-scope tasks such as data interpretation, comparative analysis, or mathematical operations on the data points.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The explicit text instructions enforce a strict one-to-one mapping between the symbol and the item being represented. This accurately reflects the constraint to present the pictograph without any condensed scale.
